# Auto-generated CMakeLists.txt for republisher nodes
# Converted to ROS2 ament_cmake format
# Do not edit manually - this file is generated by ros2repub-gen.sh

# Get parent build directory (since we're in a subdirectory)
get_filename_component(PARENT_BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR} DIRECTORY)

# List of all republisher executables
set(REPUBLISHER_NODES
    arm_control_command_republisher
    arm_control_data_republisher

    magic_body_imu_republisher
)

# Create PascalCase symlinks for message headers (ROS2 generates lowercase filenames)
# This allows code to use PascalCase include paths as generated by ros2repub-gen.sh
# .msg files are already PascalCase, but ROS2 generates lowercase .hpp files
set(MSG_DIR "${PARENT_BINARY_DIR}/rosidl_generator_cpp/${PROJECT_NAME}/msg")

# Create a custom target to create symlinks
# Note: We don't use DEPENDS here because the target name is different in subdirectory context
# Instead, we'll add dependencies on individual executables
add_custom_target(${PROJECT_NAME}_create_symlinks ALL
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "Creating PascalCase symlinks for message headers..."
    COMMENT "Creating PascalCase symlinks for message headers"
)

# Get list of message files to create symlinks for
file(GLOB MSG_FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../msg/*.msg")
foreach(MSG_FILE ${MSG_FILES})
    get_filename_component(PASCAL_NAME ${MSG_FILE} NAME_WE)  # Already PascalCase
    # Convert PascalCase to lowercase with underscores
    string(REGEX REPLACE "([a-z])([A-Z])" "\\1_\\2" LOWERCASE_NAME "${PASCAL_NAME}")
    string(TOLOWER "${LOWERCASE_NAME}" LOWERCASE_NAME)
    
    # Create symlink command for each message
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME}_create_symlinks POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E create_symlink "${LOWERCASE_NAME}.hpp" "${PASCAL_NAME}.hpp"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MSG_DIR}"
        COMMENT "Creating symlink: ${PASCAL_NAME}.hpp -> ${LOWERCASE_NAME}.hpp"
        BYPRODUCTS "${MSG_DIR}/${PASCAL_NAME}.hpp"
    )
endforeach()

# Create executables for each republisher
foreach(NODE_NAME ${REPUBLISHER_NODES})
    add_executable(${NODE_NAME} ${NODE_NAME}.cpp)
    
    # Add ROS2 dependencies
    ament_target_dependencies(${NODE_NAME}
        rclcpp
        std_msgs
    )
    
    # Link LCM library
    target_link_libraries(${NODE_NAME}
        ${LCM_LIBRARIES}
    )
    
    # Include directories for LCM headers and source
    target_include_directories(${NODE_NAME} PUBLIC
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../..
        ${LCM_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    )
    
    # Ensure messages are generated and symlinks are created before building executables
    # Note: In subdirectory context, we need to use parent directory's target name
    # The message generation happens in parent CMakeLists.txt, so we rely on
    # rosidl_get_typesupport_target which already handles this dependency
    if(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME}_create_symlinks)
        add_dependencies(${NODE_NAME} ${PROJECT_NAME}_create_symlinks)
    endif()
    
    # Link to generated message types (using new ROS2 API)
    # This automatically adds include paths for generated message headers
    rosidl_get_typesupport_target(cpp_typesupport_target ${PROJECT_NAME} "rosidl_typesupport_cpp")
    target_link_libraries(${NODE_NAME} "${cpp_typesupport_target}")
    
    # Explicitly add include directory for generated message headers
    # Generated headers are in: build/lcm_to_ros2/rosidl_generator_cpp/lcm_to_ros2/msg/
    # So the include directory should be: build/lcm_to_ros2/rosidl_generator_cpp
    target_include_directories(${NODE_NAME} PUBLIC
        ${PARENT_BINARY_DIR}/rosidl_generator_cpp
    )
    
    # Install executable
    install(TARGETS ${NODE_NAME}
        DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME}
    )
endforeach()
